body.name: Theta_ell_R
body.def: \(\Theta_{\ell,R}\) is the semialgebraic set of normalized coordinates \(\theta=(\gamma,\beta,u,v,m^{S})\) satisfying \(\gamma\prod_{i\in I_{\ell}}(u_i-\gamma)(v_i-\beta u_i)\ne0\) and, for every \(j\in J_{\ell}\), admitting \(w^{S}_{j,k}\ge0,x^{S}_{j,k}\in\mathbb R\) indexed by \(k\in K_R\) with \(\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}=1\), \(\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}x^{S}_{j,k}=0\), \(m^{S}_{j,r}=\sum_kw^{S}_{j,k}(x^{S}_{j,k})^r\) for \(0\le r\le R\), and \(m^{S}_{j,2}>0\); the corresponding original graph chart is \(a_i=1,b_i=u_i-\gamma,c_i=v_i-\beta u_i\).
